title: NFL quarterback Sam Hartman named as the next Bachelor
summary: The Washington Commanders player will lead season 30, which starts in March.
body:
Washington Commanders quarterback Sam Hartman will be the star of the 30th season of The Bachelor, ABC announced today on Good Morning America.

Hartman, 27, is from Charlotte, North Carolina. He played college football for Wake Forest and Notre Dame before joining the Commanders in 2024.

A new night

The season begins on Sunday 21 March 2027 at 8 p.m. Eastern time on ABC, and will stream the next day on Hulu. The show is moving to Sunday nights for the first time.

He is the first professional footballer to lead the show since Jesse Palmer, who is now its host, in season five.

Sources: Variety, Deadline, ABC News.
